findings.highlight: After going through all that trouble to invite her
findings.evidenceJa: せっかく一念発起して誘ったのに
findings.governingReading: Her tease frames the invitation as a rare act of determined courage or initiative.
findings.explanation: Taiga says Shirou finally worked up the resolve to invite Rin, but English says he went through trouble.

findings.highlight: I'm going to send her home right away!
findings.evidenceJa: 余計なコトする前に家にたたき帰す
findings.governingReading: Once she returns, he will finish their business and drive her home before she can do anything unnecessary.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s plan to send Rin home before she does anything extra loses its preventive condition.
